newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 76,000 barrels in the week ended March 14 to 304.70 million barrels from 304.62 million in the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 4.61 million barrels in the week to 242.90 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 3.54 million barrels to 103.35 million barrels from 106.89 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 3.22 million barrels to 35.86 million barrels from 39.08 million.
It said gasoline production fell 113,000 barrels in the week to 7.13 million bpd from 7.24 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks fell 4.32 million barrels in the week to 198.17 million barrels from 202.49 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 90.4 percent from 89.5 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 2.17 million barrels to 36.01 million barrels from 38.18 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 13.72 million barrels from 13.58 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 40.61 million barrels from 41.01 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 7.85 million barrels per day from 7.51 million, API said.
